fact: Government Paper No 3 of 2007, the National ICT Policy (Maitlamo), was approved by the National Assembly in August 2007, as stated by the Minister of Communications, Science and Technology.

The full policy text is held, published by the Ministry of Communications, Science and Technology as Government Paper No 3 of 2007 (document published 2007-08, hosted on a UN public administration site).

The contents list a Maitlamo governance structure of an Information Age Council, an ICT Legal Reform Taskforce, an enhanced Department of Information Technology and an e-Governance Structure; the section text was not captured, so the mandate is read from the headings.

The report's Botswana chapter refers to the National ICT Policy 'Maitlamo' as Botswana's existing policy, whose aim it frames as accelerating socioeconomic development through faster, cheaper, more transparent government services (citing Paradigm Initiative 2021); it gives no adoption date and no scope description, and no date is given for the statement, so the document's published date (2025-12-01) is used.
